items.q: What is included in a logo?
items.a: Main logo, symbol, variants for light and dark backgrounds and files for print and screen.

items.q: How many proposals do we get?
items.a: Usually two or three directions, then we develop the one you choose.

items.q: Can you update our existing logo?
items.a: Yes, sometimes a refresh is enough instead of a new one.
A manual showing how logo, colours and typefaces should be used.
